task.title: Remove deprecated browser UI and architecture Mermaid source
task.summary: Remove the deprecated web Control Room surface, `/wiki-ui` launcher/docs/tests, browser-specific dependencies if unused, and `.codewiki/kb/system/architecture.mmd` after active code/docs render or reference canonical YAML instead.

goal.outcome: Deprecated browser UI and hand-maintained Mermaid architecture source are removed or reduced to an explicit deprecation shim, leaving terminal/Pi TUI plus canonical YAML as the active UX/source path.
acceptance: No active docs or README advertise the standalone browser Control Room as supported product direction.
`/wiki-ui` is removed or returns only a clear deprecation message pointing to terminal commands; behavior is covered by tests or removed from command registration tests.
`src/ui/web/**` and browser Control Room tests are removed unless a small compatibility shim is explicitly justified.
`.codewiki/kb/system/architecture.mmd` is removed from active KB source; active docs and code reference `.codewiki/kb/system/diagrams/architecture.yaml` or generated views instead.
Unused browser-only dependencies such as `cytoscape` are removed only if typecheck, smoke tests, architecture checks, and pack dry-run prove they are unused.
Package README, system/product UI docs, and file-structure ownership maps align with terminal-first UX and no stale browser source truth.
Pi extension injects or appends a small CodeWiki contract only when CodeWiki config/context applies.
Contract tells agents to use wiki_state, respect canonical/generated/runtime boundaries, route semantic work through CodeWiki loops, and avoid hand-editing generated state.
Detailed loop instructions remain in skills; prompt does not duplicate full skill docs.
Tests or smoke coverage prove prompt injection/resource loading behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement full terminal renderer in this task.
Do not remove backend/API graph/state capabilities.
Do not rewrite immutable historic builds or validation reports that reference old web UI or architecture.mmd.
Do not implement new `/wiki board`, `/wiki diagram`, or `/wiki trace` commands here unless needed as a deprecation fallback.
Do not build a full terminal app or full graph renderer.
Do not move full CodeWiki skills into Pi base prompt.
Do not rename workflow skill folders in this task.
Do not implement optional direct CLI distribution.
